messages:
Maya: quick async pulse — what I did: finished the embed cache perf test (2x throughput on staging). blockers: found one regression with long-context LRU eviction causing higher cold latency. today: rolling a patch to fix eviction threshold + coordinating canary.

Alex: nice! thanks. can you @Parul on the eviction tweak so we can include it in the canary?

Parul: on it. looked into the cache logs, the eviction jitter happens when seq_len > 2048 and cache hits drop. patch PR up: #1023. needs review for the config flag name.

Sam: flagged in the launch checklist — if canary looks good we should flip the routing rule to prefer cache-enabled models for internal beta. I can run the smoke after the flip. :thumbsup:

Maya: PR review incoming, Alex can you sanity-check the config name? naming consistency matters for Dedicated templates.

Alex: skimmed PR. suggest renaming flag to `cache_eviction_window` instead of `eviction_ttl` — matches runtime metric names. small change.

Parul: updated PR description and renamed flag. also added a quick smoke script:
```bash
# run 100 warm requests
for i in {1..100}; do curl -s -X POST $CANARY_URL -d '{"input":"token test"}'; done
```

Maya: perfect. ops-bot, can you schedule the canary deploy for 11:30 PT?

ops-bot: scheduled canary deploy for 11:30 PT (1754244600). Notifying oncall and runtime team.

Sam: after canary I'll run the checklist: smoke, latency histogram, cost-per-token sanity. If anything looks off we roll back and debug.

Alex: small ask — please ping me on the PR if the smoke shows any tokenization mismatch. last time we had a subtle tokenizer update.

Maya: noted. otherwise, no other blockers from product side. will post quick rollout note in #eng-releases once canary passes. :rocket:
